The [[Iyra]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[F'tral]] used a '''language''' that had both spoken and [[Writing/Legends|written]] forms. When written, the [[Language/Legends|language]] employed characters composed of curves and dots.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12" /> In the Iyra tongue, the word ''F'tral'' meant "[[Water/Legends|water]]" and was also the name of the Iyra's aquatic [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] the Iyra [[sentientologist]] [[Tem Eliss]] wrote the first draft of a document titled: ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''. In an intro to the document Eliss included his signature, written in the Iyra language.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Iyra language was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1989]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> The [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', also for the ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', provides a graphical depiction of Iyra script.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12" />
